cases.title: SafePay ransomware — AA26-293A triage
cases.notes:
SOURCE
CISA / FBI / USSS / LKA RLP / NCA / NWROCU joint advisory AA26-293A, 20 Oct 2026. IOCs observed Nov 2024 – Aug 2026.

WHAT TO DO FIRST
- block the actor-attributed IPs (Bacloud, exfil hosts); review, do not block, the CDN / GitHub / Google ones
- hunt for ShareFinder.ps1, SharpShares.exe, netscan*, dcsync.exe, Socks_werfault.exe
- patch CVE-2024-40711 / 40766 / 2023-27532 / 20269 / 2020-3259 on edge devices
- MFA on VPN, lockouts, offline immutable backups

OPEN
- Bacloud RFI outstanding
- no .onion / leak-site address in the advisory

items.title: SafePay affiliate (unidentified)
items.body: No individual identified. Uses Mullvad VPN exits, phished account profiles and stolen or brute-forced VPN credentials. Lives off the land, then installs AnyDesk / TeamViewer to push the locker. A "representative" phones victims after encryption.

items.title: 600+ victims — businesses & critical infrastructure
items.region: North America · South America · Europe · Australia
items.impact: Data exfiltrated (RClone / FileZilla / b2), backups wiped, files encrypted with .SafePay, leak-site extortion

items.title: Tools repurposed by the actors
items.body:
7-Zip · FileZilla · Mimikatz · PowerShell · PsExec · RClone · ScreenConnect · ShareFinder.ps1 · WinRAR · WinRM · AnyDesk · TeamViewer · Acronis Disk Director · SharpShares · NetExec · Backblaze b2.exe

Legitimate on their own; the advisory warns not to attribute them as malicious without evidence.

todo.text: Collect the ransom note and sample hash
Confirm the entry point from VPN / edge logs
Inventory what was exfiltrated before encryption
Decide on negotiation posture and notify counsel
Block at the perimeter and search 12 months of proxy / firewall logs
Ask Bacloud abuse desk for subscriber details (RFI)

comments.text: VirusTotal 14/92 on 09 Nov; last CISA sighting Aug 2026 — treat as stale-but-live until Bacloud answers.

items.title: Vilnius, Lithuania — UAB Bacloud (AS61272) hosting soc.dll C2
items.body: RDAP: LT-BACLOUD, UAB Bacloud, AS61272. Hosts 88.119.167[.]239, the soc.dll command-and-control address in the advisory. VirusTotal: 14/92 vendors flag the IP.

items.title: Falkenstein, Germany — Hetzner CLOUD-FSN1 hosting client login panels
items.body: RDAP: CLOUD-FSN1 (Hetzner, DE). Hosts 167.235.225[.]149, listed as "client login panels".
Encryption: ChaCha20 stream cipher with RSA key exchange; full or partial by file type/size; extension .SafePay; binary deletes itself afterwards.

judgement.text: We assess with high confidence that SafePay is a financially motivated ransomware operation that enters through stolen or brute-forced VPN credentials and known edge-device CVEs, stages data with RClone / FileZilla / b2 to 5.255.11[.]134 and 37.10.71[.]188, destroys backups and encrypts with a ChaCha20 / RSA locker (.SafePay). Infrastructure in the advisory is hosted at Bacloud (LT) and Hetzner (DE).
judgement.dissent: Several listed IPs belong to Cloudflare, GitHub and Google ranges; they are more likely tooling downloads or victim-side traffic than actor infrastructure. Treat them as context, not blocklist candidates, unless the hosting providers confirm abuse.
